episodes.program: (rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (for/fold ((out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0))) ((obj (in-list (objects g 0)))) (let* ((hh (obj-h obj)) (ww (obj-w obj)) (color (cond ((= hh ww) 4) ((> ww hh) 2) (else 3)))) (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) color)))))

(rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (for/fold ((out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0))) ((obj (in-list (objects g 0)))) (let* ((hh (obj-h obj)) (ww (obj-w obj)) (color (cond ((= hh ww) 4) ((> ww hh) 2) (else 3)))) (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) color)))))

(rule!
 (let* ((objs (objects g 0))
        (divider (car (filter (lambda (obj) (and (= (obj-h obj) (rows g)) (= (obj-w obj) 1))) objs)))
        (split (obj-c1 divider))
        (controller (filter (lambda (obj) (< (obj-c2 obj) split)) objs))
        (payload (filter (lambda (obj) (> (obj-c1 obj) split)) objs))
        (stage
         (for/fold ((out g)) ((obj (in-list controller)))
          (let* ((hh (obj-h obj))
                 (ww (obj-w obj))
                 (color (cond ((= hh ww) 4) ((> ww hh) 2) (else 3))))
           (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) color))))
        (wide-regions
         (filter (lambda (obj) (and (= (obj-color obj) 2) (< (obj-c2 obj) split)))
                 (objects stage 0)))
        (k (length wide-regions))
        (target (list-ref payload (- k 1)))
        (hh (obj-h target))
        (ww (obj-w target))
        (color (cond ((= hh ww) 4) ((> ww hh) 2) (else 3))))
  (paint-cells stage (obj-cells target) color)))
